student_teacher_ratio_sd.title: Neraca Pendidikan Daerah (NPD) 2025 — Rasio Pendidik : Peserta Didik
student_teacher_ratio_sd.note: Ratio is displayed by NPD as a rounded integer (for example 1:12). This is the official NPD ratio; it preserves the existing 'Rasio Murid terhadap Guru' definition.

damaged_classrooms_pct.title: Jumlah Ruang Kelas Menurut Kondisi — SD dan SMP, 2025
damaged_classrooms_pct.note: Computed from official counts: Rusak Sedang + Rusak Berat divided by total classrooms (Baik + RR + RS + RB), SD + SMP.

notes: Mixed by indicator, not by region: NPD supplies the SD student-teacher ratio; the Kemendikdasmen 2025 API supplies classroom-condition counts. Both are 2025 and cover 514/514 domestic kab/kota.
